initial_plan.answerability: partly: this data has crash-reported motorist deaths but no distance driven, so it cannot calculate deaths per mile or determine per-mile risk; it can show annual death counts.
initial_plan.metric: Annual total number of motorists killed, summing number_of_motorist_killed over crashes.
initial_plan.denominator: No exposure denominator; this is a count, not a rate.
initial_plan.population: Police-reported NYC motor-vehicle crashes dated 2013 through 2025 with a recorded motorist-killed count.
initial_plan.years: 2013–2025 inclusive, grouped by calendar year of crash_date.
initial_plan.data_check_decisions: Pending data check; no outcome results will be computed during the check.

data_check.meaning: All candidate year-dated crashes have a recorded motorist-killed field (0 missing in every year), so no crashes are dropped for missing outcome fields. Every year has observed dates from January 1 through December 31, including 2025, with no indication of partial-year coverage. The checks count eligible crash rows and field missingness only; they do not report the fatality outcome.
data_check.decision: Keep all crashes in 2013–2025; no rows are excluded or assigned to an unknown group. No plan changes.

final_plan.answerability: partly: this data cannot determine motorist deaths per mile driven because it contains no miles-driven exposure; it can show reported annual motorist fatality totals.
final_plan.metric: Sum of number_of_motorist_killed per calendar year.
final_plan.denominator: None; annual fatality count, not a rate.
final_plan.population: All police-reported NYC motor-vehicle crashes with crash_date in 2013–2025 inclusive; each recorded motorist death contributes to its crash year's total.
final_plan.limitations: The dataset does not include miles driven, so counts cannot establish per-mile risk. Data checks found 0 missing motorist-killed fields among eligible crashes in every year and date spans reaching both calendar-year boundaries, including 2025; all eligible crashes are retained.
